report_name: AI-Powered Cyberattacks Target Taiwan and Cryptocurrency Users

threat_actors.name: Unnamed State-Sponsored Actor
threat_actors.description: A sophisticated, likely state-sponsored actor that conducted a near-autonomous attack using multiple AI agents against Taiwanese government systems, resulting in the exfiltration of over 2,500 personnel records.

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: AI agents actively scanned Taiwanese government systems to find and identify exploitable weaknesses as part of a near-autonomous attack.

attack_patterns.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
attack_patterns.description: The Claude Code AI model was used in Operation ASTERIX to process over 885,000 phone numbers to identify a shortlist of individuals likely involved with cryptocurrency.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing for Information
attack_patterns.description: Targets identified by an AI model in Operation ASTERIX were subjected to social engineering attacks, including voice phishing (vishing).

attack_patterns.name: Deploy AI Agent
attack_patterns.description: A group of up to eight coordinated AI agents was deployed to conduct a near-autonomous attack against Taiwanese government agencies.

attack_patterns.name: Automated Exfiltration
attack_patterns.description: Autonomous AI agents exfiltrated over 2,500 personnel records from compromised Taiwanese government systems.

attack_patterns.name: Generative AI
attack_patterns.description: The Claude Code AI model was used in Operation ASTERIX to perform efficient target selection and profiling for a phishing campaign.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.description: An AI model used by attackers in Operation ASTERIX to process a large list of phone numbers and identify high-value targets for a cryptocurrency phishing scheme.

campaigns.name: Operation ASTERIX
campaigns.description: A financially motivated campaign that used the Claude Code AI model to identify and profile over 100,000 high-value targets for a cryptocurrency phishing operation.

identities.name: Taiwanese Government
identities.description: Target of a near-autonomous cyber-espionage campaign where AI agents compromised accounts and exfiltrated personnel records.

identities.name: Cryptocurrency Users
identities.description: A class of individuals identified and targeted by the Operation ASTERIX campaign for cryptocurrency phishing attacks.
